立人工智能安全监管和评估体系"}]}],"implementation_notes":"This is China's 2017 New Generation AI Development Plan (新一代人工智能发展规划), a high-level national strategy document issued by the State Council. It is primarily a strategy/roadmap document with three-phase goals to 2030. While it directs ministries to develop laws, regulations, and standards, it does not itself constitute binding law. Safety and governance provisions are largely aspirational with implementation delegated to future rulemaking. The document explicitly calls for future development of AI laws, ethics frameworks, safety monitoring systems, and standards—meaning most enforcement mechanisms are anticipated rather than operative at time of publication. Confidence scores for enforcement mechanisms are conservative given this forward-looking character.","confidence":0.88}
